tw-mi-benton-lake-stage-gold.st: No contemporary report of the robbery has been found; this is likely a later legend.

acc: About 100 of the 240 parcels within 2.5 km are Marinette County Forest (county forest rules; detecting may need a permit); the rest is mostly private: ask permission.

cr-wabeno-bank-loot-1921.st: In 1912 this was cut-over lumber-company land; the 1938 aerial shows brush, swamp strips and faint logging trails but cannot single out where the car was found.
src: Ogle, Atlas of Marinette County, 1912, p. 46 (Wisconsin Historical Society W0174RP)

wd4-trimbelle-zopp.st: No buildings on the 80 by 1939; the nearest 1939 farmstead stands just west of the quarter-line road.
